decision: Scan set: Full Car + 4 doors (Interior folder) + Hood/Hood Removed, Fender/Fenders Removed, Front+Rear Bumper (Warped)/Off/Removed, Rear Hatch Closed/Fully Open, Doors and Hood Open; all levelled with one rigid transform (tools/level.py from huracan-evo, ground normal 0.038,0.038,0.999) + 180 deg yaw so front=-Y, car's right=-X like ferrari-296; all prepped --like car4.json
why: Artec raw frame had the car diagonal in XY and tilted 3 deg; one shared transform keeps every state registered; same axis convention lets me reuse ferrari-296 shot tooling

decision: Registration verified for every part: colour-over-grey renders (regview.py) + nearest-surface median: doors FL 1.4 / FR 2.0 mm, state scans 1.2-2.0 mm, hood 2.4, fender 1.7, warped front bumper 4.4 (ICP would shift 10.7 mm), warped rear bumper 2.7, rear bumper removed 4.1 mm
why: Brief: check each part registers by rendering it over the car; warped bumpers both visibly cover the car's bumper with no offset so they are used; Interior Doors Open (5 mm, 12 % overlap) not used as a fill

decision: Door scans are mostly door cards (only FL has a full outer skin); exploded doors = door scan + the full car's own skin inside each door's YZ outline (tools/build.py), opening filled from 'Doors and Hood Open'
why: Flying FR/RL/RR doors as captured would show big holes in the outer skin; the car scan has the real outer skin in the same frame

decision: Hood opens on a fitted hinge (tools/hinge.py): axis ~X at the hood's rear edge (prepped y=-1.084 z=1.098), -54.9 deg = the open hood captured in 'Doors and Hood Open' (median 2.2 mm); bay under it from 'Hood Removed'
why: Fitting to the real open capture makes the motion physically right; verified by rendering the rotated hood red over the open-hood scan (coincides)

decision: Rear hatch has no part scan: panel = Hatch Closed points that moved in Hatch Fully Open AND that the fitted hinge carries onto the open lid within 12 mm (136,840 of 200k points); hinge at the roof edge (y=1.434 z=1.517), +69.8 deg, median 3.7 mm
why: Plain closed-vs-open differencing also caught wheel-arch/quarter fragments (coverage differences between captures); render check showed red shards on the arches until the hinge-consistency filter was added

decision: KD-tree queries on vertex-clustered meshes must be bounded (distance_upper_bound) and de-duplicated
why: An unbounded query against car4 (many duplicate centroids) ran >10 min without finishing; bounded + unique runs in seconds

decision: Structure: front 3/4 turntable -> rear 3/4 orbit -> wheel close-up -> rear light-bar close-up -> hood opens -> hatch opens -> top-down where the four doors pop out sideways -> exploded view (doors stay out, hood/bumpers/fender/hatch separate, orbit front-left to rear-left, all fly home and lock) -> logo
why: Brief order (turntables, extreme close-ups, hood/trunk open, top-down, exploded, logo); doors popping out from straight above is the cleanest read of 'four doors exploding out', and keeping them out across the cut gives continuity into the explode

decision: Close-up detail = Macan Electric's full-width rear light bar (car3 3 mm), not the headlights
why: The light bar is this car's signature; the headlights scan has a stray strand and sits mostly inside the body

decision: Left front fender only in the explode
why: Only one fender part scan exists (car's left, 1.7 mm median); 'Fenders Removed' fill restricted to x>0 so the right side keeps its fender

decision: Rear licence plate blanked (tools/deplate.py, adapted from mazda-miata-na) in car3/car4, the warped rear bumper and every composite; plane fitted to the OUTERMOST surface per 10 mm cell
why: Plate characters were fully legible in the 3 mm scan (light-bar preview). The Macan plate is tilted ~20 deg in front of a flat backing: a plain fit flattened the backing and left the characters - caught only by rendering the plate close up after flattening

decision: car4 re-prepped --like the saved original car4.json after deplating (root_location identical, verified)
why: Lesson: never re-normalise after edits without --like; keeps every part and hinge pivot pinned

decision: Explode panels stack above the car (hood +1.35 m, hatch +1.15, bumpers +0.6 up / 0.5 out, fender 0.55 out 0.8 up); orbit radius 6.0-7.1 m (was 7.6-8.8)
why: First 30 % preview: fore/aft bumpers made the set ~7 m long so the car read small in 9:16 (240SX/lexus lessons: stack in layers above)

decision: s4 detail = 55 mm slide along the light bar + PORSCHE lettering + Macan script, framed above the plate
why: 45 mm framing still had the plate filling the lower third; the bar and badges are the detail worth seeing

decision: Shots with animated parts render with Cycles persistent data off (tools/shot.py)
why: Sibling sessions found scenes going unlit from the frame an animated part starts moving when persistent data is on
